name: support
definition: The supplied evidence increases entitlement to the frozen claim under the declared adjudication policy.

name: undercut
definition: The supplied evidence weakens entitlement to the frozen claim or a premise/source authority on which it depends.

name: qualify_authority
definition: The evidence narrows the authority, eyewitness status, scope, or conditions under which the claim may be used without necessarily negating its descriptive content.

name: rehabilitate
definition: Later evidence defeats or substantially weakens an earlier undercutting reason and thereby restores entitlement previously reduced.

name: interpretive_accretion
definition: An editorial layer adds an interpretation at a broader explanatory/historical scale than is licensed by the base observation alone.

name: identification_update
definition: Later evidence changes the adjudicated entitlement to a prior identification of place/person/source/referent.

name: unresolved
definition: The available documentary/evidential state permits materially different epistemic assignments under the declared policy.
